tracks.title: Matthew Entwistle - Dont You Ever
tracks.activationEvidence: Official MedleyDB activation confidence, original source seconds 80–87: S02 piano: minimum 0.9991, mean 0.999934. All published activation samples are >=0.5. Primary data: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/marl/medleydb/537bb7bad0601fc58e4fff8404f71658b86ef60e/medleydb/data/Annotations/Activation_Confidence/v2/MatthewEntwistle_DontYouEver_ACTIVATION_CONF.lab . Original preview start is the 30-second source start plus the RELATIVE 7-second start: https://github.com/sigsep/sigsep-mus-cutlist-generator/releases/download/v0.3/30s_previews.csv and https://github.com/sigsep/sigsep-mus-cutlist-generator/releases/download/v0.3/7s_previews.csv . This suite uses an explicit 6.5-second subset of the nominal 7-second release (actual decoded preview is 6.8 seconds). Activation metadata supplies no chord or polyphonic-note truth.
